main_text.l: tionibus. Hac enim ratione unico verbo,
imo unica particula omnia Reformato-

cam: Non.
Ex Maronitis vero, praeter ea, quæ ha-
bentur in Catechismo, plures de hac etiam
materia scripserunt, inter quos tamen Ga-
briel Klahi vir doctissimus, & in omni lit-
terarum genere eruditissimus, integrum
edidit Opusculum, quo petulantia ora re-
tundi facile poterunt, si Epistolæ limites
hoc nobis permitterent. Sed alias, & op-
portuniori occasione, Deo sospitante.
Melchitæ hoc de argumento fusè agunt
in suo Catechismo, ubi inter cætera hæc
subijcitur:
هرذ ـــــه على الاعتراف
Adhortatio ad Confessionem, ligata oratione,
ut facilius memoriae tradatur, & reti-
neatur.
بغير الاعتراف لا عحد لك توبة. ولاعو ذنب ولو قتلت شهيدا :ولو صمت كل الدهر بالمسك والعيا .واحفيت طي الركبتين مديدا :ولو سجدت يدك فى الارض بالعطا .

page.notes: Arabic verse is set in a small, worn type; the letters inside words such as "عحد", "عو", "العيا" and "مديدا" are doubtful and not checked against a source, so they may contain errors. The Arabic line after "subijcitur" is partly illegible and was copied only as far as it could be read. The right-margin mark after "op-" could be a reference letter ("r") or a printer's sign; it is uncertain. The catchword "على" and signature "Tt" are placed as printed at the foot.
